Kaal — Terms of Service
Last updated: May 2026

By using Kaal ("the App"), you agree to these terms. The App is intended for users 13 years of age and older.

Subscription & Billing. Kaal Pro is a paid subscription billed monthly ($5.99/mo) or annually ($35.88/yr). You may cancel at any time through your App Store account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period. No refunds for partial periods.

Restore Purchase. If you previously purchased Kaal Pro, tap "Restore purchase" in Profile → Edit profile to restore access.

Data. Tasks, habits, and notes are stored locally and optionally synced to our servers. You may export or delete your data at any time. We do not sell your data to third parties.

GDPR / Data deletion. Users in the EU may request deletion of all personal data by going to Profile → Edit profile → Delete account. Data is deleted within 30 days.

Age requirement. The App is not directed at children under 13. By creating an account, you confirm you are 13 or older.
